summary_1line: After Kripa is rescued, Arjuna challenges his teacher Drona, respectfully saluting him before the two begin a fierce, evenly matched duel of arrows.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna on white horses salutes his teacher Drona on a red-horsed chariot before their duel begins amid a tense battlefield.
Drona and Arjuna stand on opposing chariots as their arrows fill the sky like dark clouds, dimming the sun above the battlefield.
Arjuna’s golden-feathered arrows blanket Drona’s chariot until the preceptor appears like a blazing mountain wrapped in fire.
